title: Blog posts by Will Grant
subtitle: Will Grant is a User Experience (UX) professional based in the United Kingdom with over 20 years of experience, including as a practitioner and strategic director. Will has an extensive background in overseeing the design, accessibility, and usability of web and mobile products that have reached a global audience of over a billion users.
